about: Daily exam news for the start-page pill and the 'Latest exam news' list on /exam-notifications.html. Not site updates. Refreshed every morning (scheduled task, Anil 17 Nov 2026). Newest first is not required; the build sorts by date. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD the news came out), tag (Notification, Admit card, Exam date, Result, Answer key, Last date, Correction window, Notice), short (pill text, under about 80 characters), text (one or two sentences for the list), url (the board's own website), via (news source used, if not the board's site), exam (site exam id, optional, for a Practise link).

items.short: TGPSC AEE (Electrical), R&B Department: CBT on 13 December 2026
items.text: TGPSC has scheduled the computer-based test for Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) in the Transport, Roads and Buildings Department (Notification No. 02/G/RB/2026) on 13 December 2026, with forenoon and afternoon sessions. The web note with the schedule is on the TGPSC website.

items.short: APPSC: only one OTPR ID per candidate; multiple IDs strictly prohibited
items.text: APPSC has issued an important notice that a candidate must not hold more than one One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) ID.

items.short: APPSC Thanedar (Forest): walking test call letters out
items.text: APPSC has released the call letter (memo), the physical fitness certificate and a web note for the walking test for Thanedar in the A.P. Forest Subordinate Service (Notification No. 13/2025).

items.short: TGPSC Assistant Scientist (TGPCB): provisional selection for 1 HH vacancy out
items.text: TGPSC has released the provisional selection notification and the selected candidate's marks for the one hearing-impaired (HH) vacancy of Assistant Scientist (Analyst Grade-II) in the Telangana Pollution Control Board (Notification No. 01/OG/PC/2026).

items.short: TGPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer (TGPCB): medical board on 18 and 19 Nov
items.text: For Assistant Environmental Engineer posts in the Telangana Pollution Control Board (Notification No. 02/OG/PC/2026), TGPSC has called visually impaired (VH) candidates to the medical board on 18 November and hearing-impaired (HH) candidates on 19 November. Details are in the web note on the TGPSC website.

items.short: SSC CPO 2026 Paper-I on 23-28 Nov; exam city status is live
items.text: SSC CPO (SI in Delhi Police and CAPFs) 2026 Paper-I runs from 23 to 28 November. The exam city and admit card status is live on ssc.gov.in; candidates flagged for Class 10 detail mismatches must upload their Class 10 marksheet by 20 November. Admit cards come 2-3 days before each shift.

items.short: APPSC: edit option opened for 2026 applications (Group-I, Forest posts, EO and more)
items.text: APPSC has opened application correction for its 2026 notifications, including Group-I (No. 07/2026), Forest Range Officer, Forest Section Officer and Forest Beat Officer, Executive Officer Grade-III, Industrial Promotion Officer, Analyst Grade-II and others. It also published a corrigendum for FRO, FSO, FBO and Group-II.

items.short: SSC GD Constable 2026: PET/PST admit cards out
items.text: SSC has released the physical test (PET/PST) admit cards for candidates who qualified in the GD Constable written exam (Constable GD in CAPFs and SSF, Rifleman GD in Assam Rifles). Check your physical test date on the admit card.

items.short: APPSC Group-II 2026: detailed notification out, apply online now
items.text: APPSC has published the detailed notification for Group-II Services (Notification No. 37/2026) and opened online applications. Reports put the screening test on 21 February 2027; check the notification for the posts and the last date.

items.short: IBPS RRB PO (Officer Scale-I) prelims call letters out; exam 21-22 Nov
items.text: IBPS has released the call letters for the RRB Officer Scale-I (PO) preliminary exam, to be held on 21 and 22 November 2026, on ibps.in.
